findingsCorrected.finding: SecurityContextHolder was stated as unconditionally thread-local, although the effective strategy is configurable.
findingsCorrected.correction: Name MODE_THREADLOCAL as the default, inspect active strategy and decorators, preserve authoritative framework read paths, and avoid changing JVM-wide strategy during request handling.

findingsCorrected.finding: The phrase 'copies per child thread' did not distinguish inherited map state from a shared mutable SecurityContext.
findingsCorrected.correction: Specify that, with inheritance enabled, standard strategy setContext values pass by reference and child authentication mutation can affect the parent. Retain fresh-context/restoration requirements and add versioned primary sources and hostile validation guidance.

sources.verifiedClaim: Default storage strategy, selectable implementations, and warning against changing strategy during active requests.
Inheritable supplier returns the installed SecurityContext; setContext does not clone it.
Default childValue uses the parent value; inheritance can be disabled by thread construction.
Dynamic scope, nullable bindings, absence, capabilities and structured inheritance; tested key final-API contracts.
CallableOp typed exception and normal/exceptional binding restoration.
Bindings captured at scope creation and StructureViolationException when fork occurs under different bindings.
